title: Unit 9 Writing App — Cause and Effect + YOUR Game
subtitle: Landing screen → 📘 Student Book (read & underline the model · sort cause/effect · connector lab · build your own chart · write · edit checklist) · 📒 Workbook pp.114–115 (analyse the model · word map · 4 sentences · free writing) → ⚽ Can Leo Score? quiz. 11 modules total.

content: Read Isabelle's model on SB p.158 and underline all nine connectors.
Sort halves of a sentence into cause and effect.
Build a two-column cause-and-effect chart for a game Leo chooses, then turn each row into a sentence.
Write the paragraph, then run the 4-point edit checklist over it before sharing.
Complete the Workbook p.114 model analysis and word map, write 4 connector sentences, and finish with free writing (WB p.115).
Score at least 80% on the Can Leo Score? quiz.
language: Use because and as for causes, and so, so that and as a result for effects.
Punctuate as a result correctly: full stop before, comma after.
Choose so that when the result was the goal, and so when it just happened.
Use a and an on first mention and the every time after that.
Read the related action words in context: bounce, dive, slide, practice, dizzy.
